title: CPDLC over ATN-B1 Vulnerabilities
overview: Affected Products CPDLC over ATN-B1 Vulnerabilities Standard: Advisory Circular 90-117 Data Link Communications Product Version: Advisory Circular 90-117 Data Link Communications ATN-B1 CPDLC: vers:all/* Product Status: known_affected Remediations None available Currently, there is no mitigation available for CVE-2025-71409, CVE-2025-71410, CVE-2025-71411, CVE-2025-71412, CVE-2025-71413. Mitigation These vulnerabilities in the CPDLC protocol stack are exploitable in a lab environment. However, they require very specific conditions to be met and are unlikely to be exploited outside of a lab setting. Mitigation Organizations observing suspected malicious activity should follow established internal procedures and report findings to CISA for tracking and correlation against other incidents. Mitigation No known public exploitation specifically targeting these vulnerabilities has been reported to CISA at this time. These vulnerabilities have a high attack complexity.
